\par\vspace{-4pt}\noindent\begin{minipage}{\textwidth}\scriptsize Classification rules (pre-registered): calibrated if the Wilson interval contains 5\% with upper limit $\leq$ 7.5\%; overall null calibration INCONCLUSIVE. The advected-driver scenario contains wind-dependent structure without methane transfer; its rejections show the test cannot identify transport and are not Type-I errors. The N2a lower Wilson limit is 3.2465\% (an earlier report rounded it to 3.3\%). Source: E12 summary\_by\_scenario\_method.csv, verdicts.json.\end{minipage}
